control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 %, check the line tracker (below 90 % curve left, above 95 % curve right, else avoidWalls); if the light is bright, call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 %, turn right on an obstacle on the left, turn left on one on the right, else driveInTheDark; if the light is bright, driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %, else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop, else followLine.
followLine: on black curve left (10/40), else curve right (40/10).
